author: ginie1
body:
Uh I want to try this server out and see if it's a good place to play.

Some info about me

Timezone:EST

Leader of Street Sharks on OCN(Current best team).

One of the best shotcaller on OCN. So I can do that for your team if you need me to.

Good at the pvps.

Pretty active.

Can Frontline/Offend.

Never finished below 3rd in an OCN tourney. Won 5 out of 11.

Pretty loyal player. 

Since my background, I would prefer to join a top tier team, but if not. I can probably help make your team a top tier team. Type your skype below if you're intrested.

Thanks! :)
